WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM account_totals
)
SELECT
    at.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    at.total_amount,
    at.transaction_count,
    1.0 * at.total_amount / gt.total_amount AS fraction_of_all_accounts
FROM account_totals AS at
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = at.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt
ORDER BY fraction_of_all_accounts DESC
LIMIT 10;
